items.source: This is the most flexible of the Converter SPI interfaces, but also the most complex. It is flexible in that a GenericConverter may support converting between multiple source/target type pairs (see getConvertibleTypes()). In addition, GenericConverter implementations have access to source/target field context during the type conversion process. This allows for resolving source and target field metadata such as annotations and generics information, which can be used to influence the conversion logic.
items.translation: 这是 Converter SPI 接口中最灵活但也是最复杂的一个。其灵活性在于 GenericConverter 可以支持在多个源/目标类型对之间进行转换（参见 getConvertibleTypes()）。此外，GenericConverter 实现在类型转换过程中可以访问源/目标 field context。这使得能够解析源和目标字段的元数据（例如注解和泛型信息），从而用于影响转换逻辑。

items.source: This interface should generally not be used when the simpler Converter or ConverterFactory interface is sufficient.
items.translation: 此接口通常不应在更简单的 Converter 或 ConverterFactory 接口已足够时使用。

items.source: For conditional converters this method may return null to indicate all source-to-target pairs should be considered.
items.translation: 对于条件转换器，此方法可返回null以表示应视为所有源到目标对。

items.source: Each entry is a convertible source-to-target type pair.
items.translation: 每个条目都是一个可转换的源到目标类型对。

items.source: Convert the source object to the targetType described by the TypeDescriptor.
items.translation: 将源对象转换为由 `TypeDescriptor` 描述的 `targetType`。

items.source: Implementations may additionally implement ConditionalConverter.
items.translation: 实现类还可以额外实现ConditionalConverter。

items.source: Holder for a source-to-target class pair.
items.translation: 源到目标类对的持有者。

items.source: Return the source and target types that this converter can convert between.
items.translation: 返回此转换器可以转换的源和目标类型。

items.source: source - the source object to convert (may be null)
sourceType - the type descriptor of the field we are converting from
items.translation: sourceType - 我们正在转换的字段的目标类型描述符

items.source: targetType - the type descriptor of the field we are converting to
items.translation: targetType - 我们要转换到的字段的类型描述符
